## STEP 1: Master Directory Structure

```
ws/
├── index.html                          # Root entry — loads selected game via hash or query param
├── package.json                        # Vite + Three.js (r160+) + post-processing deps
├── vite.config.js                      # ESM build, dev server on /:game/:id
├── CRAFT.md                            # Working method doc
├── AGENTS.md                           # Project rules

├── shared/                             # Reusable utilities — imported by every game
│   ├── audio/
│   │   └── SoundEngine.js              # Web Audio API synth: oscillators, envelopes, reverb
│   ├── input/
│   │   └── InputManager.js             # Unified Keyboard + Gamepad API with deadzone & sensitivity
│   ├── math/
│   │   ├── MathUtils.js                # Vec3 helpers, lerp, clamp, angle wrapping
│   │   └── Noise.js                    # Simplex / Perlin noise for procedural generation
│   ├── pool/
│   │   └── ObjectPool.js               # Generic typed object pool (recycle, acquire, release)
│   ├── particles/
│   │   └── ParticleManager.js          # Centralized manager — hard cap 500, burst/spark/explosion primitives
│   ├── vfx/
│   │   ├── CameraShake.js              # Trauma-based shake: intensity decay, velocity scaling
│   │   ├── HitStop.js                  # Timescale dilation on heavy impacts (0.1–0.3s freeze)
│   │   └── MotionTrails.js             # Trail renderer for fast-moving objects (pos history + line segments)
│   ├── ui/
│   │   └── UIManager.js                # Glassmorphism overlay: HUD, score, menus, floating text
│   └── index.js                        # Barrel re-export of all shared modules

├── games/                              # Each game in its own isolated directory
│   ├── <GameName>/                     # e.g. space_invaders/, pac_man/, etc.
│   │   ├── main.js                     # Bootstraps scene, camera, renderer, loop
│   │   ├── config.js                   # Game constants: speeds, counts, dimensions, tuning
│   │   ├── systems/
│   │   │   └── Physics.js              # Hand-written collision / physics for this game
│   │   ├── entities/
│   │   │   ├── Player.js               # Player entity (movement, state, rendering)
│   │   │   ├── Enemy.js                # Enemy base class + per-type subclasses
│   │   │   └── Projectile.js           # Projectile pool entry (velocity, lifetime, damage)
│   │   ├── components/                 # Reusable behaviors attached to entities
│   │   │   └── ...                     # e.g. HealthComponent, ScoreComponent
│   │   ├── ui/
│   │   │   └── GameUI.js               # Game-specific HUD overlay (score, lives, power-ups)
│   │   └── index.html                  # Game-specific HTML entry (optional — root can route)
│
├── node_modules/                       # Dependencies (gitignored in real repo)
└── dist/                               # Production build output
```

### Shared Utilities Summary

| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `shared/audio/SoundEngine.js` | Web Audio API synth — oscillators, ADSR envelopes, master gain, reverb bus. Zero external audio files. |
| `shared/input/InputManager.js` | Unified dual-input: WASD/Arrows + Gamepad API with configurable deadzone, sensitivity curves, and button remapping. |
| `shared/math/MathUtils.js` | Lightweight Vec3 ops (no full library), lerp, clamp, angle normalization, dot/cross products. |
| `shared/math/Noise.js` | Simplex noise implementation for procedural terrain, texture displacement, spawn patterns. |
| `shared/pool/ObjectPool.js` | Generic typed pool — `acquire()`, `release(obj)`, `clear()`. Pre-allocated arrays to avoid GC pressure. |
| `shared/particles/ParticleManager.js` | Centralized particle system — hard cap 500, burst/spark/explosion primitives, per-particle lifetime/color/velocity decay. |
| `shared/vfx/CameraShake.js` | Trauma-based camera shake: intensity accumulates on impact, decays exponentially per frame, scales with impact velocity. |
| `shared/vfx/HitStop.js` | Frame-freeze / timescale dilation — injects a brief pause (0.1–0.3s) on heavy impacts for "juice." |
| `shared/vfx/MotionTrails.js` | Trail renderer — stores position history per object, renders as fading line segments or instanced geometry. |
| `shared/ui/UIManager.js` | Glassmorphism overlay system: backdrop-filter blur, neon glow accents, floating 3D/HTML score text, responsive layout. |

### Import Path Convention

Games import shared modules via relative paths from their own directory:

```js
// games/space_invaders/main.js
import { SoundEngine } from '../../shared/audio/SoundEngine.js';
import { InputManager } from '../../shared/input/InputManager.js';
import { ObjectPool } from '../../shared/pool/ObjectPool.js';
import { ParticleManager } from '../../shared/particles/ParticleManager.js';
// ... etc.
```

### Vite Configuration Strategy

- Single `vite.config.js` at root with a dev server that rewrites paths: `/games/<name>/` → serves `<game>/main.js`.
- Three.js + post-processing (EffectComposer, UnrealBloomPass) installed as npm deps at root.
- All games share the same build output; each game is a distinct entry point or dynamically loaded module.

---

### Compliance Statement

**Anti-Lazy Directive:** I affirm that every function written will be fully implemented — no `// ... rest of function`, no placeholders, no stubs. Every method body will be production-ready and self-contained.

**Strict Memory Management:** I affirm explicit `.dispose()` calls on all geometries, materials, and textures when entities are destroyed or pooled. Object pooling eliminates GC pressure on projectiles and particles. The ParticleManager enforces a hard 500-particle cap with automatic recycling.

**Sequential Output Protocol:** I affirm that I will not generate any files in this step. I await your command to name the game, after which I will produce `plan.md` (Step 2), then upon approval, write every file specified therein (Step 3).
